title: CHAPTER 021 - Safe v3.6 activation and controlled handover
description: Whole automated chapter: verify local v3.6 candidate and helper, create backup, attempt controlled handover, verify resulting runner/process state, and always terminate this v3.5 task without retry-loop. Detailed PASS/FAIL evidence is written to C:\3EN-Agent\chapter-021-v36-handover.txt.
backup: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $root='C:\3EN-Agent'; $report=Join-Path $root 'chapter-021-v36-handover.txt'; $stamp=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'; $bk=Join-Path $root ('backups\021\'+$stamp); New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $bk | Out-Null; @('3en-agent-runner-v3.5.ps1','3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1','switch-to-v36-020a2.ps1','state.json') | ForEach-Object { $p=Join-Path $root $_; if(Test-Path $p){ Copy-Item $p $bk -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } }; Set-Content -Path $report -Encoding UTF8 -Value @('=== CHAPTER 021: SAFE V3.6 HANDOVER ===',('START='+([DateTime]::Now.ToString('s'))),('BACKUP_ROOT='+$bk)); Write-Host ('BACKUP_ROOT='+$bk); Write-Host 'CHAPTER_021_BACKUP=PASS'
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $root='C:\3EN-Agent'; $report=Join-Path $root 'chapter-021-v36-handover.txt'; $v36=Join-Path $root '3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1'; $helper=Join-Path $root 'switch-to-v36-020a2.ps1'; function R([string]$s){Add-Content -Path $report -Encoding UTF8 -Value $s; Write-Host $s}; R '--- READ / EVIDENCE ---'; $v36Exists=Test-Path $v36; $helperExists=Test-Path $helper; R ('V36_EXISTS='+$v36Exists); R ('HELPER_EXISTS='+$helperExists); $hash=''; if($v36Exists){try{$hash=(Get-FileHash $v36 -Algorithm SHA256).Hash}catch{$hash='HASH_ERROR'}}; R ('V36_SHA256='+$hash); $expected='57233841FF0F7F6BF78E5EBEB77D0ECCDC2EA07634A81595F31E88B85E8B4B54'; $hashOk=($hash -eq $expected); R ('V36_HASH_MATCH='+$hashOk); $v36Syntax=$false; if($v36Exists){try{$t=$null;$e=$null;[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($v36,[ref]$t,[ref]$e)|Out-Null;$v36Syntax=(@($e).Count -eq 0);R ('V36_SYNTAX_ERRORS='+@($e).Count)}catch{R ('V36_SYNTAX_CHECK_ERROR='+$_.Exception.Message)}}; $helperSyntax=$false; if($helperExists){try{$t2=$null;$e2=$null;[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($helper,[ref]$t2,[ref]$e2)|Out-Null;$helperSyntax=(@($e2).Count -eq 0);R ('HELPER_SYNTAX_ERRORS='+@($e2).Count)}catch{R ('HELPER_SYNTAX_CHECK_ERROR='+$_.Exception.Message)}}; $pre=$v36Exists -and $helperExists -and $hashOk -and $v36Syntax -and $helperSyntax; R ('PRECHECK_PASS='+$pre); R '--- CONCLUSION / ONE LOGICAL CHANGE ---'; if($pre){try{R 'HANDOVER_ATTEMPT=START'; & $helper 2>&1 | ForEach-Object {R ('HELPER> '+$_)}; R ('HELPER_EXITCODE='+$LASTEXITCODE); R 'HANDOVER_ATTEMPT=COMPLETED'}catch{R ('HANDOVER_EXCEPTION='+$_.Exception.Message)}}else{R 'HANDOVER_ATTEMPT=SKIPPED_PRECHECK_FAILED'}; R 'SCRIPT_PHASE_FINISHED_NONLOOPING=TRUE'
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $root='C:\3EN-Agent'; $report=Join-Path $root 'chapter-021-v36-handover.txt'; function R([string]$s){Add-Content -Path $report -Encoding UTF8 -Value $s; Write-Host $s}; R '--- TEST / FINAL EVIDENCE ---'; $v36=Join-Path $root '3en-agent-runner-v3.6.ps1'; $expected='57233841FF0F7F6BF78E5EBEB77D0ECCDC2EA07634A81595F31E88B85E8B4B54'; $hashOk=$false; if(Test-Path $v36){try{$hashOk=((Get-FileHash $v36 -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -eq $expected)}catch{}}; R ('FINAL_V36_HASH_MATCH='+$hashOk); $procs=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'powershell|pwsh' -and $_.CommandLine -match '3en-agent-runner-v3\.6\.ps1' }); R ('V36_PROCESS_COUNT='+$procs.Count); $v35procs=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'powershell|pwsh' -and $_.CommandLine -match '3en-agent-runner-v3\.5\.ps1' }); R ('V35_PROCESS_COUNT='+$v35procs.Count); $state=Join-Path $root 'state.json'; if(Test-Path $state){try{$raw=Get-Content $state -Raw; R ('STATE_PRESENT=TRUE'); R ('STATE_RAW='+($raw -replace '\r?\n',' '))}catch{R 'STATE_READ=ERROR'}}else{R 'STATE_PRESENT=FALSE'}; $pass=$hashOk -and ($procs.Count -ge 1); R ('CHAPTER_021_RESULT='+(if($pass){'PASS'}else{'FAIL_REVIEW_REPORT'})); R ('END='+([DateTime]::Now.ToString('s'))); Write-Host 'CHAPTER_021_TERMINAL_NONLOOPING=PASS'
rollback: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $root='C:\3EN-Agent'; $report=Join-Path $root 'chapter-021-v36-handover.txt'; Add-Content -Path $report -Encoding UTF8 -Value 'ROLLBACK_REQUESTED_BY_USER=TRUE'; Write-Host 'Rollback is intentionally not automatic in Chapter 021 because this task is designed to terminate safely even when handover verification fails. Backup path is recorded in the report.'
